sloka: तथा वन्गान् कलिन्गाम् च कौशिकान् च समंततः ।अन्वीक्ष्य दण्डक अरण्यम् स पर्वत नदी गुहम् ॥४-४१-११॥
transliteration: tathā vangān kalingām ca kauśikān ca samaṁtataḥ ।anvīkṣya daṇḍaka araṇyam sa parvata nadī guham ॥4-41-11॥

translations.english: 'Look for Sita in the countries of Vidarbha and Rishika, in the picturesque country of Mashaka, Vanga and Kalinga and all over Kausika. Look for her in mountains caves and on river banks, in Dandaka forest, in Godavari, in Andhra also in Pundra, Chola and Pandya countries and all over Kerala.
